description: Sensible defaults for a live Cavalry 2.8.0 reference clone: 1920x1080 at 30 or 60 fps, _mg preset-library rigs, Stage 3 settle-normalized trajectory fitting, Stage 4.5 local bbox solver (maxPosError <= 1.5px, maxScaleError <= 2%, llmTokens: 0) and Stage 5 SSIM verification (>= 0.92). Every value can be overridden per run; the clone:live runner merges this template under its CLI flags.
notes: comp.width/height/fps are defaults: the runner overrides them with the measured frame dimensions and --fps.
decomp.cropSpecs use the x,y,w,h[:name];... syntax. Empty means: tokens + beat grid only, no vector asset tracing.
gate.ssimThreshold is the Stage 5 acceptance gate; escalationSsimGate is the structural-retry threshold (an LLM turn is justified only below it).

presets.entrance 'auto' resolves one entrance preset from the 120-preset library — preset rigs ship demo content parameters, so the deterministic lane defaults to 'none' and the zero-slop pipeline reports below-gate honestly instead of animating invented copy. Set 'auto' (or author params in --plan) only when placeholder content is acceptable.
Per-element motion cloning of arbitrary footage needs tracks: pass --plan with tracks/manifest from a procedural/autoanalyze run.
